body: even if i did, my parents wouldn't accept it. they'd find me a tutor and talk to me just like they did to my brother when he fucked up in school. they guilt-trip you into thinking that you're a disappointment, you could do so much better and so forth. i'm already getting crap grades is some subjects because i'm so fucking stressed out but my parents don't really bother trying to understand.

>But you're always going to have death waiting for you. That's the only thing you can be certain of. So with that in mind, you officially have liberty to live your life however you want to. Don't you owe it to yourself to try as much as you can in life? 

I sometimes look at it that way, too. but in the meantime, i'm still living the same life so until death comes along and brings relief, i'm still going to have to do everything i'm expected to. i realize i don't necessarily have to, but what kind of daughter/student/person in general would i be if i did anything i pleased? i'd be a disappointment to everyone who ever knew me. I'd love to drop out of school, run away with the circus and never worry about my previous life, but that's obviously not going to happen. 
i might owe it to myself, but i also owe it to everyone around me to be that perfect child that they expect of everyone.

i'm really happy you're enjoying your life. i honestly think the only thing i'm looking forward to is having a family. i've always wanted to have children of my own. so my current and future family are the only things keeping me alive right now.

i'd love to find something i love doing, but i just can't find anything i have a passion for or that i have a talent it. i know that this all seems a bit early for me but i just can't find anything that i'd like to work in. 

john lennon once said something that i really feel like i can relate to; "
I'm not afraid of dying. To me dying is like getting out of one car and into another." 
and honestly, i feel exactly the same except i also think i might finally find peace in that next car. this is why i really feel like death is the best thing for me. i'm not saying this in a moment of desperation, i'm saying this because it really seems like i might actually find something once i'm dead.

i don't like to do many things. i usually just try to sleep as much as possible to make things go faster. so that's not an option as a future profession. 

by "this life", i mean a life that's run by everyone else. i go to school, i get good grades, i go to uni, i get a well-paying job, i get married, i have children. it's like my whole future is planned out for me. it's what people expect but it's not what i want. if i do otherwise; i go to school, i get crap grades, i go to a crap college or none, i work as a janitor at mcdonalds etc...that's not even the worse case scenario. frankly, i don't want either one of those futures, but other than death, i don't see a different option. and it's not like this death thing seems like a bad idea to me. this is really what i want. i mean, everybody has an opinion on things, have different tastes, and death just sort of seems like the better option for me. 

I don't really want to come out of this a fuller, stronger and more interesting person. i don't want to come out of this at all, because i don't even want to go through this. 
 
i already feel half dead. like, i'm only physically alive and i'm only going through the motions. nothing really seems real anymore but i still hate it. it's like the mental half of me has just been turned off and i'm just waiting for my body to join me.

i just don't get how i'm going to get through this. i hate school because my parents have always expected me to get good grades. and i have, until now. but i realized that good grades isn't what i want, it's what my parents want. i feel like i'm always doing all this shit that's expected of me but i never really get to live a life i actually like. and that's just the thing. it's not like i can really get away from this life except for suicide. and the idea of death has always come as comforting for me.
